articles.title: Wall Street gets new crypto rival after Texas bank completes regulatory pivot
articles.snippet: By establishing a national charter under the executive branch, United Texas Bank said it intends to enable AI-driven payment rails to intercept global digital dollar volumes.

articles.title: A bipartisan bridge to the future: Why the Senate must finish the job on digital Assets
articles.snippet: The Clarity Act’s recent markup proved that the momentum for regulation is there. It is imperative that Congress move the bill forward to establish rules this generation needs and a framework the next will inherit, urges Kim.

articles.title: Crypto advocacy group challenges Senator Warren's claims on OCC charters
articles.snippet: After Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren's claimed that the comptroller may have violated US banking laws by approving crypto companies’ charters, The Digital Chamber urged the regulator to defend the applications.

articles.title: OpenAI Foundation Pledges $250 Million to Help Cushion AI's Economic Disruption
articles.snippet: The philanthropic arm of ChatGPT maker OpenAI will fund research, worker support, and new models for sharing the gains from automation.

articles.title: UK Issues Sanctions Against Justin Sun's HTX, Other Crypto Firms Over Alleged Russia Ties
articles.snippet: British financial institutions are now barred from doing business with the exchanges—and may face penalties for interacting with crypto transactions that pass through them.
